cues: Acetic acid ionises a little into acetate and hydrogen ions.
Now add sodium acetate, a salt that floods the solution with acetate.
Hydrogen ion concentration falls, and the p H rises, even though we added more acetic material.
text: Acetic acid ionises a little into acetate and hydrogen ions. Now add sodium acetate, a salt that floods the solution with acetate. The equilibrium shifts left. Hydrogen ion concentration falls, and the p H rises, even though we added more acetic material.
